content: विशारद {%a.%} .²1 Clever, skilful or proficient in, versed in, conversant with (usually in <ab>comp.</ab>); नानाशस्त्रप्रहरणाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः <ls>Bg. 1. 9</ls>; मधुदानविशारदाः <ls>R. 9. 29</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 17</ls>. .²2 Learned, wise. .²3 Famous, celebrated. .²4 Bold, confident. .²5 Beautifully autumnal. .²6 Lacking the gift of speech. .{@-दः@} The Bakula tree.
